Specification: This module defines a bounded model-checking wrapper around a single-node specification by restricting some actions based on the length of the history. It extends another module and introduces one constant, HistoryLimit, to cap the number of events recorded in the history. The specification defines bounded variants of selected actions, combines them into a next-state relation, and asserts a standard temporal specification consisting of the imported Init predicate and a box-action formula over the bounded next action.
